scope: Review art: all 18 existing crops, 6 new flowers, 6 orchard trees, 4 existing forest trees. Production gameplay unchanged.

entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Original Agora pixel-art sprite atlas, true transparent alpha. Use attached approved crop atlas as STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Beautiful deliberate crisp 16-bit pixel clusters, olive/sage foliage, cool teal shadows, warm upper-left highlights, selective dark colored outline. Match reference detail, no smooth vector shapes, no blur, no white sticker border, no text, no grid, no backgrounds, ground patches or shadows. Upright front view with visible top surfaces for a 35-degree tilted 2.5D world. EXACT equal-width 5 columns by 3 rows, 15 fully separated sprites. Wide gutters, no cell overlap, at least 12% padding each side. Common baseline near bottom of each cell. Each row same species with consistent scale and evolving silhouette; early sprouts much smaller than maturity. Landscape 5:3 atlas.
Each ROW shows five growth stages left to right: 1 tiny two-leaf sprout; 2 small distinctive seedling; 3 leafy juvenile without fruit; 4 near mature flowering or forming produce; 5 harvest-ready mature plant with clearly visible produce. Distinct developmental art, not scaled copies. Roots stay very short for planting into soil. No pots or supports.
ROW 1: Clover bulb: round creamy-lilac edible bulb with trifoliate clover leaves.
ROW 2: Pearl onion: ivory onion bulb with slim upright tubular sage-green leaves.
ROW 3: Ember pepper: branching compact plant, pointed leaves, cream blossoms and slender scarlet peppers.

This sheet shows ORCHARD TREES, detailed logical 96px mature sprites. FIVE columns: 1 tiny rooted seedling with two or three leaves; 2 sapling with thin woody stem and a few branches; 3 young tree with branching small canopy; 4 fully grown tree in blossom; 5 SAME fully grown tree full of ripe fruit. Mature trees have honest branched trunks, irregular clusters of leaves, visible root collar but NO ground patch. Full crown and roots contained in cell. Maintain same mature trunk position and canopy dimensions in last two columns. Trees are much larger in-game than vegetables.
ROW 1: Apple tree: broad rounded spreading crown, fresh green leaves, warm brown trunk; white-pink spring blossom, bright red apples.
ROW 2: Cherry tree: graceful spreading branching crown, deep green leaves, textured reddish-brown trunk; pink blossoms, small paired crimson cherries.
ROW 3: Peach tree: airy open crown, long narrow pointed sage leaves, slender honey-brown trunk; rose pink blossoms, warm coral-gold peaches.
